sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: An Arctic moss of wet limestone cliffs in north-western North America. It forms dark mats on rock and is restricted to strongly calcareous substrates. Its small capsules open by longitudinal valves and measure about 0.6–2 mm. Microscopic characters are needed for reliable identification.

sections.title: Related mosses and uses
sections.text: It differs from similar Andreaea mosses by its calcareous habitat and robust leaf costa. The sources consulted do not establish food use or toxicity.
